svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Develop and use AI driven recommendation engines that use user themes, semantic memory and
listening history to match users with similar preferences → Deliver personalized content
and recommendations to users

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Let users input their interests openly through frequently given feedback forms in order to
tailor their experience → Deliver personalized content and recommendations to users

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Leverage social sharing and integrate social media to enhance recommendations from what pe
ople share with friends or family → Deliver personalized content and recommendations to us
ers

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Offer long-time listeners customized recommendations based on their listening history → De
liver personalized content and recommendations to users

ylists → Strengthen community engagement among listeners and bring communities of users to
gether

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Avoid disrupting the listening experience by placing ads only at the start or the end of p
odcasts and not in between → Balance ad load so that the frequency and placement of ads do
es not distract or detract the user from the experience

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 待确认联系 · 范围具体化
Minimize ads for new users in order to encourage exploration and obtain preference data →
Balance ad load so that the frequency and placement of ads does not distract or detract th
e user from the experience

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Implement targeted advertising that shows users relevant ads and minimizes disruption → Mo
netize the platform while maintaining a positive user experience, keeping a balance betwee
n the two sides

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Offer a premium subscription that gives users an ad free experience for a monthly or yearl
y payment → Monetize the platform while maintaining a positive user experience, keeping a
balance between the two sides

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Provide transcriptions and closed captions for each and every podcast → Ensure high qualit
y standards for podcast content

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Give users multiple ways to watch or get the experience of a podcast → Help people with sp
ecial needs get hold of the content and enjoy it to the utmost point

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 待确认联系 · 范围具体化
Help people with special needs get hold of the content and enjoy it to the utmost point →
Improve accessibility features in the platform

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Enable users to navigate Spotify via voice and via their keyboards → Improve accessibility
features in the platform

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Support multiple languages and dialects → Improve accessibility features in the platform

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Support multiple languages and dialects → Broaden the reach of the platform, especially to
non-English speakers

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Bring people from multiple ethnic backgrounds and varying languages onto the podcast platf
orm → Broaden the reach of the platform, especially to non-English speakers

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Ask users open-ended questions every now and then about whether they enjoyed a podcast and
what else they want to listen to → Avoid content saturation so that users can easily disc
over new podcasts

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Diversify what users get: do not restrict them to only what the algorithm feeds them, and
offer fresh, new and more unique content rather than only what they ask for → Avoid conten
t saturation so that users can easily discover new podcasts

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Bring new creators onto the platform, offering them deals other platforms would not offer
→ Do not constrict the platform to a limited number of creators who would then have a mono
poly over it

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Segregate podcasts by content category so that suggestions give users what they actually n
eed → Deliver personalized content and recommendations to users

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Focus on and prioritize the user recommendation system above other improvements → Give use
rs the right experience as soon as they log on to Spotify

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Detect and flag inappropriate or prohibited content with moderation tools and automated sc
reening, so that the platform does not become an anarchy where anyone just uploads anythin
g → Ensure high quality standards for podcast content

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 待确认联系 · 实现方式
Evaluate every podcast through a strict process pipeline → Ensure high quality standards f
or podcast content

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于

tead of losing them to competitors such as Youtube music because they disliked the content
